Tree cover — Kern River Golf Course

Measured tree height from the WRI/Meta model (v2, 0.973 m/px). A building is as tall as an oak and reads the same to a height model, so the right pane drops ground whose top is flat: local height spread under 1 m across a 7-pixel window, measured over tall pixels only so a roof edge sees roof rather than the drop to the ground. The number that matters is whether the chute figures survive that filter — if they collapse, we were drawing houses.
